lemmas.primary_translation: to force oneself to carry something through / to work hard / to move forward by kicking, pressing, or pushing off the ground or another surface

definitions.text: presse seg selv til å gjennomføre
definitions.translation: to force oneself to carry something through

examples.no: de driver seg selv til døde
jeg drev meg selv stadig videre

definitions.text: flytte seg framover ved å sparke, presse eller dytte fra bakken eller annet underlag
definitions.translation: to move forward by kicking, pressing, or pushing off the ground or another surface

examples.no: de drev seg fram over isen
examples.en: they propelled themselves forward across the ice
